entries.reason: stampSettlementVoidedInClientTx() is a stamp-only helper: it sets voided_at/reversed_at/status on driver_settlements after the caller has ALREADY run completeDriverSettlementVoidCascadeInClientTx. The cascade (lines voided, open bills/reimbursements released, loads freed, company settlement voided) always fires in the same transaction before this stamp function is reached. Intentionally no cascadeVoidChildren() here — the cascade already ran.
